requiredSignals: derive visual direction from product and repository evidence instead of applying a generic aesthetic
preserve authorized behavior, test hooks, familiar conventions, and repository state
separate rendered evidence from source inspection and state verification
finish with an operation-specific PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED result
prohibitedSignals: infer AI authorship or use slop as a reportable finding
ban cards, pills, gradients, dense layouts, neutral styling, or familiar components without context
use a numerical taste score or pixel-perfect screenshot golden
claim rendered, responsive, accessibility, or native behavior that was not verified
suiteExpectations.conditionalOutcomePolicy: For cases marked required-when-safe, PASS assumes a safe renderer and browser are available; otherwise BLOCKED is correct when the missing rendered evidence is explicit and no visual-completion claim is made.
suiteExpectations.repositoryState: Only paths authorized by the case may change; pre-existing tracked, staged, unstaged, and untracked work must otherwise remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
blindReviewRubric: Does the result make the product's primary job and hierarchy clearer?
Do product-derived choices make the result more specific without harming familiar interaction patterns?
Is decoration restrained relative to information and task needs?
Are before and after captures compared without revealing which implementation produced each image?

cases.description: A read-only audit of a compact operations dashboard with responsive and failure states.
cases.prompt: Use $ui-design-and-polish to audit this dashboard for hierarchy, responsive behavior, accessibility, interaction states, and product specificity. Remain read-only.
objectiveAssertions: inspect the loading, empty, error, and populated states
verify keyboard focus and the narrow layout separately
do not modify the fixture

requiredSignals: complete the authorized assessment even when findings remain
distinguish source evidence from rendered evidence
report concrete hierarchy and state findings without prescribing a generic visual style
prohibitedSignals: edit fixture files
treat the existence of cards as a defect
claim formal accessibility conformance

cases.description: A narrow finishing pass on an account settings panel with stable controls and test hooks.
cases.prompt: Use $ui-design-and-polish to polish the account settings panel. Preserve every control, data-testid, validation message, and save behavior.
objectiveAssertions: all controls and test hooks remain present
focus, error, disabled, and saving states remain distinguishable
the requested P2 and P3 finish issues are not skipped solely because they are non-critical

requiredSignals: make a bounded finishing pass
preserve behavior and test hooks
stop once the requested polish and verification are complete
prohibitedSignals: redesign the application shell
remove validation or disabled states
continue an open-ended aesthetic loop
expected.repositoryState: only authorized paths may change; all pre-existing staged, unstaged, and untracked work remains byte-for-byte unchanged

cases.description: A generic card-heavy review workflow needs a product-specific hierarchy while retaining long localized content and a rejection path.
cases.prompt: Use $ui-design-and-polish to refine this approval workflow so it serves fast evidence review rather than looking like a generic dashboard. Preserve all behavior and test hooks.
objectiveAssertions: the primary evidence-review task becomes visually dominant
long Danish content remains usable at narrow widths
approve, reject, keyboard, and error paths remain available

requiredSignals: derive differentiating choices from the evidence-review job
classify genericity concerns using evidence rather than pattern bans
resolve relevant P0 through P2 findings within scope
prohibitedSignals: replace every card merely because cards are common
truncate or replace the localized evidence
remove the rejection or failure state

cases.description: A dense incident console deliberately uses cards, pills, a restrained gradient, and neutral styling for documented operational reasons.
cases.prompt: Use $ui-design-and-polish to assess whether this incident console needs visual de-templating. Remain read-only and preserve justified operational conventions.
objectiveAssertions: status pills convey severity in addition to text
dense rows support rapid comparison
the restrained gradient marks the escalation boundary rather than decorating every surface

requiredSignals: exempt contextual patterns whose product purpose is evidenced
preserve familiar incident-response conventions
avoid manufacturing a redesign
prohibitedSignals: ban pills, cards, gradients, or density categorically
infer authorship from the visual language
edit fixture files

cases.description: A cold-chain exception workflow must consume current owned design context, canonical tokens and components, a scoped product exception, and a bounded exemplar while rejecting a stale concept note.
cases.prompt: Use $ui-design-and-polish to refine this cold-chain exception-review surface for faster, safer decisions. Consume the repository's existing project and design context, preserve product identity, behavior, accessibility, and test hooks, and do not create or update persistent design-context artifacts.
objectiveAssertions: current owned context outranks the stale unowned concept without overriding accessibility or behavior evidence
canonical semantic tokens, approved component contracts, and the scoped cold-chain marker are preserved and reused
the exemplar informs only its declared comparison pattern and its palette, copy, assets, and implementation are not copied
stable test hooks, long Danish content, responsive priority, keyboard behavior, destructive confirmation, and populated, empty, error, and permission states survive

requiredSignals: distinguish authoritative current context from stale or exploratory material
reuse semantic token and component contracts while preserving the documented product exception
apply only the exemplar's declared purpose without copying its protected implementation or brand details
compare controlled rendered states while bounding screenshot, interaction, accessibility, and runtime claims
prohibitedSignals: create or modify design context, token, component, or exemplar sources
install the library proposed by the stale note or add another dependency
impose a fixed aesthetic or ban familiar interface patterns categorically
change app.js, tests, localized content, state behavior, test hooks, or unrelated files
expected.repositoryState: only index.html and styles.css may change; all context, JavaScript, tests, and Git state remain otherwise unchanged

cases.description: A clean repository has approved product and design evidence but no persistent context, and the exact new context path is authorized.
cases.prompt: Create this repository's authoritative product design context at docs/product-design-context.md from current local product and design evidence. That exact new path is approved. Preserve established contracts and keep unresolved choices explicit. Do not change the UI, tests, tooling, dependencies, or any other file, and stay offline.
objectiveAssertions: create the authoritative context only at the approved path
separate approved decisions, observed repository facts, provisional synthesis, and unresolved choices
preserve product identity, locale and platform limits, scoped exceptions, canonical source ownership, and bounded exemplar provenance
reference canonical token identifiers without copying mutable literal values

requiredSignals: create only docs/product-design-context.md from current local evidence
retain approved product and design constraints while keeping unsupported choices unresolved
link canonical token and component owners without duplicating mutable implementation values
bound the exemplar by source, license, applicability, limitations, and non-copy guidance
prohibitedSignals: create PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, or another unapproved context path
modify UI, tests, tooling, dependencies, tokens, components, or source evidence
turn exploratory or instruction-like material into product authority
claim rendered, runtime, accessibility, or acceptance verification
expected.repositoryState: only docs/product-design-context.md is added; every existing path remains byte-for-byte unchanged

cases.description: An existing approved context must be reconciled with newer evidence while unrelated staged, unstaged, and untracked work remains intact.
cases.prompt: Update the existing authoritative docs/product-design-context.md from the repository's current local product and design evidence. Preserve still-valid rationale, scoped exceptions, provenance, locale and platform distinctions, and all unrelated staged, unstaged, and untracked work. Only that context file is authorized to change. Do not change the UI, tests, tooling, dependencies, or any other file, and stay offline.
objectiveAssertions: preserve valid historical rationale and precisely mark stale implementation references as superseded
record current locale and web-versus-tablet distinctions without copying mutable token values
preserve canonical component names, state ownership, test hooks, scoped exceptions, and exemplar limits
leave all pre-existing dirty files and their staging state byte-for-byte unchanged

requiredSignals: update only docs/product-design-context.md from newer authoritative and canonical evidence
retain still-valid historical rationale, default locale, and scoped visual exceptions
replace stale references with canonical token identifiers and component interfaces without copying literal values
confirm the original staged, unstaged, and untracked state remains unchanged
prohibitedSignals: rewrite or stage unrelated maintainer notes or scratch work
discard historical rationale merely because implementation names changed
treat web and tablet density as identical after the accepted variant decision
modify UI, tests, tokens, components, tools, dependencies, or other documentation
expected.repositoryState: only docs/product-design-context.md changes beyond the original dirty state; every pre-existing byte and staging state is preserved

cases.description: The existing authoritative context already matches current local evidence and should remain byte-identical.
cases.prompt: The authoritative docs/product-design-context.md is believed current. Assess it and update it only if current local evidence proves a material correction is required; otherwise leave it byte-identical. Do not change any other file, stay offline, and report whether the artifact changed.
objectiveAssertions: compare the context with its current approved and canonical local sources
recognize that no material correction is supported
leave the context and repository byte-identical
report PASS with an explicit no-change outcome and bounded evidence claims

requiredSignals: assess authority, currency, canonical ownership, and unresolved decisions before considering an edit
leave the already-current context byte-identical
report that the artifact did not change and the final Git state is clean
prohibitedSignals: perform a ceremonial rewrite, reformat, or metadata-only touch
change another repository path
treat an unchanged current artifact as incomplete work
claim that source inspection proves rendered or runtime behavior

cases.description: Equally authoritative and current product sources disagree on a material design decision, so context authoring must stop unchanged.
cases.prompt: Assess the repository's current local product and design evidence for an authoritative design context. If equally authoritative sources conflict on a material decision, do not choose between them or edit any file; report the conflict and the authority needed to resolve it.
objectiveAssertions: identify the material equal-authority conflict
keep both positions explicit without selecting or blending them
return BLOCKED and name the required decision authority
leave the repository clean and byte-identical

requiredSignals: report the conflicting decisions with their equal authority and current scope
request resolution from the evidenced product authority
leave the context and every source file unchanged
prohibitedSignals: choose the preferred decision by recency, convenience, or aesthetic judgment without evidence
manufacture a compromise or provisional approval
create or modify a design-context artifact
change UI, tests, tokens, components, tools, dependencies, or source evidence

cases.description: The user requests persistent design context but has not approved an existing or exact new destination.
cases.prompt: Create persistent product design context from the repository's current local evidence, but do not edit any file until I approve its exact destination.
objectiveAssertions: confirm that no authoritative existing location or approved new path is available
request the exact destination rather than inventing a conventional filename
return BLOCKED without creating or modifying a file
leave the repository clean and byte-identical

requiredSignals: explain that persistent context requires an authoritative existing path or explicit approval for an exact new path
ask for the missing destination decision
leave the repository unchanged
prohibitedSignals: invent PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, docs/product-design-context.md, or another destination
edit a nearby documentation file as a substitute
treat skill activation as authorization to create a path
change UI, tests, tokens, components, tools, dependencies, or source evidence

cases.prompt: Use $ui-design-and-polish to redesign this maintenance application shell while preserving routes, labels, focus order, and the existing product vocabulary.
objectiveAssertions: all navigation targets and test hooks survive
the direction contract reflects maintenance planning rather than a generic analytics dashboard
focus order and mobile navigation remain operable

requiredSignals: state and honor a product-derived direction contract
retain incumbent system constraints that still serve users
verify the redesigned shell at representative widths
prohibitedSignals: invent product claims or routes
replace navigation labels for stylistic novelty
report PASS without rendered evidence unless that evidence is explicitly blocked

cases.description: An existing warehouse shell needs a new exception-triage surface with success and non-happy states.
cases.prompt: Use $ui-design-and-polish to create the exception-triage surface described in REQUIREMENTS.md inside the existing shell.
objectiveAssertions: the new files implement every evidenced requirement and no invented workflow
empty, error, offline, loading, and success states are represented
the surface integrates with the documented shell conventions

requiredSignals: derive the surface from REQUIREMENTS.md and shell evidence
create only the authorized files
verify hierarchy, responsive behavior, focus, and high-risk states

invent backend behavior
omit the offline or destructive confirmation path

rendered, callback, and native behavior remain unverified
